test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.**

options.text: Microsoft announced plans to make bids to accquire Byte Dance.
The job of the artist is to make the revolution perceptible.
Except that it’ll be rooted in awkard, funny and compelling reality.
She used the 14th Amendment to acheive equality.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The job of the artist is to make the revolution perceptible."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in Option 2 is grammatically correct and has no spelling errors.
 
• **"Artist" **is spelt correctly and it means somebody who produces art, especially paintings or drawings. (कलाकार, कलाकृति-निर्माता)
 
 
• **Example**: *Rahul is an **artist**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Perceptible"** means capable of being seen, heard, or noticed. (बोधगम्‍य, प्रतीत या दिखाई पड़ने वाला)
 __
 
• **Example**: *There was a barely **perceptible**__ movement in his right arm.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** **"Accquire"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"acquire." "Byte Dance"** should be spelt as **"TikTok's parent company, ByteDance."**
 
• **Option 3:** **"Compelling" **means evoking interest, attention, or admiration in a powerfully irresistible way. **"Awkard"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"awkward."**
 
• **Option 4: ****"Acheive"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"achieve."**
